$comment: Reviewed status of the open GitHub Dependabot advisories. Every claim names how it can be re-checked. Raw npm audit output stays unsuppressed in CI (raw-production-audit artifact).

advisories.chain: dev only: eslint@10.8.0, @eslint/config-array@0.23.5 and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree@8.65.0 -> minimatch@10.2.6 (npm ls minimatch --omit=dev is empty)
advisories.status: FIXED (scoped override, outside the parents' declared ^10 range)
advisories.fix: overrides for eslint, @eslint/config-array and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree only: minimatch 11.0.3 (adds @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match 1.0.3). Not applied to the whole tree. No upstream release moves to minimatch 11: eslint 10.14.0, @eslint/config-array 0.23.5 and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.1 still declare ^10.
evidence: API used by the three parents (new Minimatch(pattern, {dot, flipNegate}).match(path, partial) and minimatch(path, pattern, {dot})) exists unchanged in 11.0.3
differential check, 10.2.6 vs 11.0.3: 68,856 cases (every tracked file plus edge paths x 19 ESLint-style patterns x dot/flipNegate x partial) gave identical results
npm run lint before/after: same 520 files, same results; an injected error, a dot file and an ignored dist/ file behave the same on both versions
fresh npm ci, npm ls --all, the repository postinstall (viem tsconfig, Zod backport 69/69) and npm run build pass
npm audit (full and --omit=dev) no longer lists minimatch; scripts/report-dependency-audit.mjs assessed set unchanged (zod, elliptic only)
advisories.risk: minimatch 11 replaces the matching engine; 11.0.0-11.0.3 and @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match were published 2026-10-26..28. The override affects only lint tooling, not the production bundle. Remove it when ESLint and typescript-eslint declare minimatch ^11.
advisories.recheck: npm ls minimatch --all; npm view eslint dependencies.minimatch; npm view @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree dependencies.minimatch

advisories.chain: @circle-fin/{bridge-kit,swap-kit,earn-kit,adapter-viem-v2,adapter-solana,provider-*,borrow-*} pin zod 3.25.67 exactly; @reown/appkit-wallet uses zod 3.22.4; root zod 3.25.76; @wagmi/connectors (porto) already on 4.6.7
advisories.reason: No zod 3.x release fixes the advisory (latest 3.25.76). Circle SDKs, including the newest @circle-fin/bridge-kit 1.16.1, pin zod 3.25.67 exactly; forcing zod 4 would break their runtime schemas.
advisories.mitigation: scripts/apply-zod-collection-backport.mjs patches the oversized-collection checks into all locked zod v3 copies (verified by scripts/verify-zod-collection-backport.mjs); only Circle Borrow (/v1/borrowKit/) and Swap (/v1/stablecoinKits/) service responses are size/shape-bounded before SDK parsing (scripts/verify-circle-response-limits.mjs). Bridge Kit and Earn Kit (/v1/earnKit/) responses are NOT bounded and reach their SDK zod schemas unbounded; they come only from Circle's TLS origins, and constrained collections are covered by the backport. Machina's own Iris recovery read (readBoundCctpAttestation) is capped at 256 KiB / 64 messages; the other Iris fee/status reads use response.json() without a size cap. Porto keeps zod 4.6.7 via overrides.
advisories.recheck: npm view @circle-fin/bridge-kit dependencies.zod; npm view zod versions

advisories.chain: @circle-fin/* -> @ethersproject/abi@5 -> hash -> abstract-signer -> abstract-provider -> transactions -> signing-key@5.8.0 -> elliptic@6.6.1
advisories.reason: 6.6.1 is the latest published elliptic version.
advisories.reachability: Not in the production bundle: elliptic-only strings (e.g. 'Signature without r or s', 'Key does not belong to curve') are absent from dist/assets. Machina never creates or signs with keys in the browser; wallets sign.
advisories.recheck: npm run build && grep -l 'Signature without r or s' dist/assets/*.js
